sources.citation: Kestelman, Harvard Joint Center for Housing Studies working paper, 2025
sources.finding: Housing growth rose 0.04 percentage points over six years (2017–2023), about 562 homes in a city of about 1.4 million. The program covered roughly 61% of the city's homes and required affordable units.

sources.finding: Each reform that loosened land-use rules was followed by about 0.8% more postal addresses three or more years later (95% interval about +0.2% to +1.4%). Only 28 of the 96 loosening reforms changed floor area, density or height.
